Internal helper: predict from a model, without the rank-deficient warning

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_predict_kept.Rd

A model whose fit dropped a term as an exact linear combination of the others (an NA coefficient) predicts from the terms it kept, and predict.lm() – which predict.glm() calls – warns "prediction from rank-deficient fit; attr(*, "non-estim") has doubtful cases" whenever the grid holds the dropped term at a value the kept terms do not imply: once for the fit plot and once per effect plot (Session 359; the S347 item). jlm() and jlogistic() have already said which term the fit dropped (.jst_warn_aliased()), and the line drawn is the kept terms' prediction, so that one warning is muffled here. Any other warning passes.

Usage

.jst_predict_kept(...)

Arguments

...

Passed to stats::predict().

Value

What stats::predict() returns.
